content:
**Power Smith** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases durability of crafted power armor and reduces the material cost.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Your crafted Power Armor now has improved durability and costs fewer materials. | 003440DA | 

Before update 60, the perk had 3 ranks. Rank 1 allowed for crafting some power armor mods. Rank 2 reduced crafting cost of power armor. Rank 3 increased the durability of crafted power armor. As of this patch, power armor mods no longer require perks for crafting.
